cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Compares a WB-2 Spreadsheet Input Manifest (expected digests) against pasted-back CSV/TSV text per manifest range (observed, e.g. after a recompute in Excel) and returns an XLR-1 round-trip receipt -- `result: "match"|"mismatch"` plus a `mismatches[]` cell list when expected_by_ref text is also supplied. SAME comparator module as the tools/ round-trip page (XLR-2/XLR-3) -- byte-identical receipt for the same inputs. Paste-intake is untrusted: finite-gate (#NUM! for NaN/Infinity) and CSV-injection sanitization apply identically to WB-1's CSV import. Verify-only -- never operates Excel, never ingests .xlsx.

expected_by_ref.description: OPTIONAL map of manifest range ref -> the actual expected CSV/TSV text (e.g. the pq-export the manifest was built from). Supplying it resolves a digest mismatch to per-cell mismatches[] entries instead of a single range-level entry.

manifest.description: WB-2 Spreadsheet Input Manifest object (input-manifest.schema.json) -- the expected side.

observed_by_ref.description: Map of manifest range ref -> pasted-back CSV/TSV text for that range (e.g. { "B2:C3": "10,widget\r\n20,gadget\r\n" }). One entry required per manifest.ranges[].ref.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp -- required, no default (pure: no wall-clock read).

produced_by.description: Identity slot for who/what produced this receipt -- required, no default (pure: no identity read).

name: workbook_roundtrip_verify
title: Verify a pasted-back Excel round-trip against a Spreadsheet Input Manifest
